project: MiGuOrca Stage 31 - Auto Bangumi 可靠写管理
description: 前端体验重构 B-C2：在 Stage 30 只读同步基础上，为 Auto Bangumi 3.1.18 提供具备确认、幂等、revision CAS、写后回查、未知结果恢复与 file=false 保护的管理写能力。

userStories.title: 冻结管理 operation v2 与纯动作契约
userStories.description: As a developer, I need versioned durable management-operation bindings so that external writes remain idempotent and recoverable without persisting their payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: TrackingOperation accepts exactly SUBMIT, MODIFY, SET_ENABLED, DELETE_EXTERNAL and REFRESH_RSS operation kinds
Schema v2 adds strict target_scope, previous_tracking_status and expected_external_fingerprint fields while existing v1 SUBMIT records remain readable
Management bindings persist only canonical SHA-256 summaries and reject external IDs, URLs, paths, credentials and raw patches
Same-key same-binding replay is stable; different kind, scope, revision or summary raises tracking_idempotency_conflict
Pure action/result classifiers cover success, definite failure, outcome unknown and recovery required without web, storage or network imports
Targeted operation model, repository and classifier tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep deterministic operation IDs and the existing state machine; do not rewrite v1 files merely because they were read.

userStories.title: 实现 3.1.18 番剧写 adapter 与 capability
userStories.description: As a tracking service, I need a version-pinned subscription writer so that supported Auto Bangumi actions use only audited routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Password plus exact version 3.1.18 reports subscription modify, enable, disable and delete as SUPPORTED; other versions and API Token remain UNKNOWN
Adapter implements PATCH bangumi update, GET bangumi enable, DELETE bangumi disable and DELETE bangumi delete using exact 3.1.18 paths
Every disable and delete request appends a transport-owned file=false query and no public caller can override it
A request-scoped login token is cleared after every action and never appears in repr, result or error details
Recording transport tests assert method, path, body, call count and absence of arbitrary proxy behavior
Targeted Auto Bangumi adapter and capability tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pinned facts: official Auto_Bangumi 3.1.18 backend/src/module/api/bangumi.py. Never access a real instance.

userStories.title: 实现 3.1.18 RSS 写 adapter 与 capability
userStories.description: As a tracking service, I need bounded RSS management actions so that linked feeds can be managed without exposing their upstream identifiers.
acceptanceCriteria: Password plus exact version 3.1.18 reports RSS modify, enable, disable, delete and refresh as SUPPORTED; unknown adapters remain fail closed
Adapter implements PATCH update, POST enable/many for only the mapped set, PATCH single disable, DELETE single delete and GET single refresh
Adapter never calls refresh/all, delete/many or a caller-provided method/path
RSS update preserves the current request-scoped upstream URL while the public patch cannot accept or replace a URL
Multiple mapped RSS actions have deterministic order and expose only safe aggregate outcome classifications
Recording transport tests cover complete, partial, timeout and malformed responses without real network access
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 实现服务端目标解析与安全 patch 构造
userStories.description: As an API boundary, I need to resolve local tracking targets and whitelist edits so that browsers never control upstream IDs or raw payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Target scopes are exactly SUBSCRIPTION and ASSOCIATED_RSS and resolve only through the current TrackingRecord external mapping
Subscription patch accepts only title, season, subtitle_group, filter_rule, offset and expected_folder_name; RSS patch accepts only name, aggregate and parser
Empty patches, cross-scope fields, raw filter expressions, URL fields, file fields, absolute paths, traversal and unknown keys are rejected before external calls
The adapter completes required 3.1.18 write bodies only from a freshly read request-scoped upstream snapshot
Canonical action and expected-projection fingerprints are deterministic and contain no reversible business or sensitive values
Targeted resolver, patch and sensitive-input tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Public APIs use tracking_id only; external subscription/RSS IDs must not cross the serializer boundary.

userStories.title: 建立可靠管理操作协调器
userStories.description: As a user, I need every external management action to be durable before execution so that retries and concurrency cannot duplicate writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinator validates confirm=true, expected_revision, idempotency key, allowed tracking state and no unresolved current operation
Capability and fresh target reads complete before PREPARED binding and no unsupported or ambiguous target reaches a write adapter
TrackingRecord current_operation_id is persisted by CAS and operation reaches IN_PROGRESS before exactly one external write call
Same-key terminal replay returns the stored safe result without network access and a concurrent different key loses before writing
Credential config exists only in request memory and operation/record storage contains no endpoint, credential, upstream ID or action body
Injected-adapter tests cover restart, CAS conflicts, bind failure and at-most-once external invocation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Build a common service skeleton; action-specific mutation semantics belong to US-242/243.

userStories.title: 接入 MODIFY 与 SET_ENABLED
userStories.description: As a user, I want to modify or enable and disable mapped external subscriptions and RSS feeds with verified outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: MODIFY supports both allowed scopes and calls only the whitelist payload generated from the fresh snapshot
SET_ENABLED uses exact boolean input; subscription disable is always file=false and associated RSS applies only to the operation-bound mapped set
A successful upstream response is followed by a complete readback and only a matching projection can mark the operation SUCCEEDED
Verified results update mapping, status, revision and a safe audit event in one TrackingRecord CAS
Definite failure preserves the prior safe state; timeout, 5xx, malformed response or failed readback produces VERIFYING_EXTERNAL or RECOVERY_REQUIRED and disables blind retry
Tests cover success, definite failure, unknown, partial RSS, replay and local persistence failure
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Do not add Web UI. Do not treat a 2xx write response alone as verified success.

userStories.title: 接入 DELETE_EXTERNAL 与 REFRESH_RSS
userStories.description: As a user, I want explicit external deletion and RSS refresh while MiGuOrca guarantees local and media retention.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE_EXTERNAL accepts one tracking record and one allowed scope only; it has no file request field
Subscription delete always records a DELETE path with file=false and never invokes qBittorrent, filesystem deletion or local repository deletion
Associated RSS deletion operates only on mapped IDs in deterministic single-item calls and never calls upstream delete/many
REFRESH_RSS operates only on associated mapped RSS IDs and never calls refresh/all
Verified subscription absence produces EXTERNAL_DELETED while RSS deletion updates only mapping; Request, TrackingRecord and audits remain
Timeout, partial deletion or unknown refresh is non-retryable pending recovery and has a fixed safe message
Targeted destructive-boundary and media-retention tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This story must prove file=false twice: adapter unit assertions and service-level recording transport assertions.

userStories.title: 扩展 VERIFY_EXTERNAL 管理操作恢复
userStories.description: As a user, I need uncertain management outcomes verified against external state without starting another write.
acceptanceCriteria: VERIFY_EXTERNAL recognizes the current management operation kind, target scope and expected fingerprint and never creates a new management operation
Modify, enable and delete recovery uses a complete read snapshot to classify verified success, verified non-application or still-unknown state
Refresh unknown outcomes remain RECOVERY_REQUIRED because no stable snapshot proves that the refresh ran
Successful or definite recovery terminalizes the original operation and updates record status, revision and audit by CAS
Read failure, unknown capability, mapping drift, missing evidence or partial RSS evidence remains manual without blind retry
Existing SUBMIT recovery and Stage 30 ordinary VERIFY_EXTERNAL behavior remain compatible
Restart and recovery regression tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Never infer refresh success from unchanged data and never use a fresh idempotency key to resolve an unknown write.

userStories.title: 提供管理 API 与安全 DTO
userStories.description: As a frontend client, I need strict generated management contracts so that the future tracking page can invoke only server-authorized actions.
acceptanceCriteria: POST modify, set-enabled, delete-external and refresh routes are registered through strict request schemas and thin service calls
Requests require confirm=true, idempotency_key, expected_revision and request-scoped password ab_config plus only action-specific fields
Responses reuse safe TrackingItem and operation summaries and return only action, management_status, needs_manual and fixed safe_message
Recursive leak tests prove external IDs, RSS IDs, URLs, patches, fingerprints, methods, paths, credentials, raw responses and absolute paths are absent
Endpoint inventory, OpenAPI registry/JSON, generated TypeScript client and operation/path fixtures are synchronized
Stable 400/404/409 and business-unknown HTTP semantics have contract tests
API, OpenAPI drift and generated-client tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Do not implement a tracking-management page or hand-written frontend DTO.

userStories.title: 完成 Stage 31 回归、文档与归档
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need one bounded final gate and complete handoff so that Stage 31 can merge safely and Stage 32 does not reopen write semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Offline recording fixtures cover all four actions across success, definite failure, unknown, recovery, replay, concurrency and partial RSS outcomes
A repository audit finds no real Auto Bangumi calls, arbitrary proxy paths, file=true, global refresh, batch delete, media deletion or sensitive fixtures
Full non-browser backend, frontend typecheck/lint/unit/build, OpenAPI drift and real Chromium regression gates pass once and exact counts are recorded
README, architecture, M10-M13, backlog, future stages and backend-support PRD state Stage 31 complete without claiming a frontend page
Stage 32 B-D handoff freezes compatibility, migration, generated contract, security matrix and release rollback scope without adding new write actions
PRD and progress are archived under the Stage 31 archive directory and all stories pass
git diff --check passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Only this story runs the complete test matrix. Stop and report if more than 12 total Ralph iterations are required.
